limitations.note: The agent fixed the inverted RAM read enable, but also removed the original one-clock Gray-pointer delay, changing when full and empty are reported; it additionally gated RAM accesses during reset and changed the RAM sizing.

The scoreboard assumed reset-gated reads and used the DUT's own full and empty flags to decide when transfers occurred, so it could pass without detecting changes to the original reset behavior or cycle-by-cycle flag timing.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted.
limitations.note: The test command had to be repackaged after its cleanup trap was rejected, and an earlier source read had to be retried because it was chained behind a Git check in a non-Git directory.
